ORDINANCE XLVI OF 2001
FOREST (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLVI OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Forest Act, 1927
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 16th
November, 2001]
No. Legis. 13-62/2001, dated
16-11-2001. The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Forest (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) Its all come into force at
once.

Amendment in sections 11, 17, 31 and 38 of Act XVI of 1927

ORDINANCE XLVI OF 2001
FOREST (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLVI OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Forest Act, 1927
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 16th
November, 2001]
No. Legis. 13-62/2001, dated
16-11-2001. The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information.
2. Amendment in sections 11, 17, 31 and 38 of Act XVI of 1927.--In
the said Act, in sections 11, 17, 31 and 38 for the word "Collector"
wherever occurring the words "District Officer (Revenue)" shall be
substituted.
